description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 24.01.2022 to 30.01.2022
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) by the Director General of Customs. It establishes new Rates of Exchange for customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements for customs operations, representing subsidiary legislation rather than government personnel or structural changes.
